info.title: API.SH: Workana
info.description: The Workana API from API.SH: public Workana data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The values /workana/v1/search accepts: categories with their subcategories (slug and name), client regions with their countries, client countries, project languages, publication periods, contract types, bid counts and client payment history.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/workana-categories

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the site's labels and links: `en` (default), `es` or `pt`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A client's public page on Workana: initials as the site shows them, country, rating, verified payment, published and paid projects (and share paid), last login, registration date, badges, about text, open projects (each like a search result) and the first ratings freelancers gave this client (score, criteria, feedback, project, freelancer initials and country). Use /workana/v1/client/ratings for more ratings. The client id comes from /workana/v1/job (`client.id`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/workana-client

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Client id (32 characters) or a workana.com/e/... link.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the site's labels and links: `en` (default), `es` or `pt`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Ratings freelancers gave a client: score, per-criterion stars, feedback, date, project (title and slug when public, skills) and the freelancer's initials and country. `total` is the client's number of ratings. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/workana-client-ratings

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Client id (32 characters) or a workana.com/e/... link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the site's labels and links: `en` (default), `es` or `pt`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Workana project: `title`, `labels`, `status`, publication date, category and subcategory (names and slugs), `description` (text and HTML), the client's answers (`details`, e.g. project size), `delivery_term`, `skills`, `bids`, `interested_freelancers`, and the client (id for /workana/v1/client, initials, country, rating, published and paid projects, verified payment, member since), plus the previous and next project slugs. The budget is shown on /workana/v1/search; logged out the project page shows only its label. `latest=true` returns the newest project.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/workana-job

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Project slug or a workana.com/job/... link. Required unless `latest=true`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the newest project on the board.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the site's labels and links: `en` (default), `es` or `pt`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Open freelance projects on Workana with every filter of the site's job board: keywords, category, subcategories, skills, client country or region, project language, publication date, fixed price or hourly, number of bids, client payment history, fixed budget range and hourly rate range. Each project: `slug`, `url`, `title`, `description` (text and HTML), `budget` (text, currency, min, max, per project or hour), `is_hourly`, `posted`, `bids`, `deadline`, `featured`, `urgent`, `client` (initials as the site shows them, country, rating, verified payment), `skills`, plus `raw`. `total` is the site's match count (it stops counting at 10,000; `total_capped`). Some keyword searches return fewer than 20 projects per page, as the site does. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/workana-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug from /workana/v1/categories (e.g. `it-programming`, `design-multimedia`).

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Subcategory slugs, comma separated (e.g. `web-development,mobile-development`).

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: Skill slugs from /workana/v1/skills, comma separated (up to 5).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Client countries as ISO codes, comma separated (e.g. `US,AR`).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Client region.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Project languages, comma separated: `en`, `es`, `pt` or `all` (default all).

parameters.name: publication
parameters.description: Published in the last 24 hours, 3 days, week, or over a week ago.

parameters.name: agreement
parameters.description: Fixed price or hourly projects.

parameters.name: bids
parameters.description: `few` = 0-4 bids, `many` = 5 or more.

parameters.name: client_history
parameters.description: `0` = clients with no payments to freelancers yet, `1` = clients with 1 or more.

parameters.name: budget_min
parameters.description: Fixed budget from (USD).

parameters.name: budget_max
parameters.description: Fixed budget up to (USD).

parameters.name: hourly_rate_min
parameters.description: Hourly rate from (USD).

parameters.name: hourly_rate_max
parameters.description: Hourly rate up to (USD).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 per page, up to 500).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the site's labels and links: `en` (default), `es` or `pt`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Skills from Workana's skills list matching a text (slug for the search's `skills` filter, name, group), best matches first; without `q` the whole list in the site's order.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/workana-skills

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to match (part of the name or slug).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of skills (default 50, max 500).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the site's labels and links: `en` (default), `es` or `pt`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
